scientific_integrity: A constructive all-orders proof is provided. A standalone finite verifier was run; finite checks do not establish the infinite theorem. Originality is qualified by historical-priority uncertainty; no independent review or independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to undirected labelled signed stars with at least three leaves and unrestricted spread-before-ignition signed two-colour burning; no theorem for general trees, deadline variants, or classes modulo automorphisms. The general switching/Hamming correspondence is credited to the source.
title: Reachable two-colour burning codes and plurality spectra of signed stars
